subject: Re: STACorp evaluation data exchange — timeline & usage guardrails
messages:
From: Alice Jennings <alice@stacorp.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial request — sharing eval dataset + testcases for MAP

Hi Priya / Ben / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profiles and the routing options. As discussed, we'd like to share a small evaluation dataset and a set of prompt/test-case snippets so we can validate quality on our side before finalizing Dedicated capacity. Before we transfer anything, legal wants a short mutual action plan (MAP) outlining:

- Deliverables and owners (what Redwood will provide, what STACorp will provide)
- Allowed use of the dataset (evaluation-only, no production inference)
- Retention window and deletion commitments
- Any redlines on embeddings/derivative data usage
- Timeline to close (we're targeting procurement signoff in early July)

Can you confirm if Redwood can accept the dataset under those constraints and provide a short MAP + template NDA? We can share a zipped prompt pack (small, ~300 prompts) and a 2GB anonymized evaluation corpus.

Also, please confirm the preferred transfer mechanism (S3 presigned, SharePoint, secure FTP).

Appreciate it — our ML lead Tom (cc'd) will be the technical point.

Best,
Alice Jennings
Sr. Product Manager, ML Platforms
STACorp

Attachments: none
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jennings <alice@stacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request — sharing eval dataset + testcases for MAP

Hi Alice — great to hear, and thanks for the clear list. Redwood can absolutely support an evaluation-only exchange under an agreed MAP + short NDA. Proposed next steps:

1) Redwood to send a one-page evaluation NDA + MAP checklist (targets, owners, timelines, data handling rules).
2) STACorp to deliver the prompt pack + anonymized dataset via presigned S3 link (we'll provide bucket & instructions).
3) Redwood to provision a dedicated evaluation workspace (isolated project), run a baseline evaluation, and return a short metrics report and failure cases within 5 business days of ingest.

Key guardrails we recommend (we can put these in the MAP):
- Evaluation-only license, no model retraining or distribution of derivatives outside STACorp and Redwood product team.
- Data retention on Redwood side: 30 days post-evaluation, after which we delete both dataset and any cached embeddings unless STACorp opts-in to a longer retained-eval arrangement.
- Audit logs and access restricted to named tech contacts (Tom + Alice on STACorp side).

I'm attaching: redwood-eval-nda.pdf (one-page), and dataset-transfer-guide.md with S3 presign instructions. If that looks good, I'll draft an explicit MAP spreadsheet with dates and responsibilities.

Proposed timeline (quick):
- 2026-06-30: NDA & MAP draft sent by Redwood
- 2026-07-01: STACorp shares dataset + prompt pack
- 2026-07-02 to 2026-07-06: Redwood runs evaluation and delivers report
- 2026-07-09: Procurement decision (goal)

Ping me if any of the guardrails are not acceptable and we'll iterate quickly.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-eval-nda.pdf; dataset-transfer-guide.md
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request — sharing eval dataset + testcases for MAP

Priya / Monica — quick internal note while we wait for STACorp:

- The 30-day retention is fine for a standard eval. If sales wants to offer a 90-day retention for enterprise customers at higher tiers, we should mark that as an optional checkbox in the MAP.
- For embeddings / derivatives: recommend explicit prohibition on persistent embedding storage on Redwood unless STACorp signs the Data Retention Addendum. We can allow ephemeral KV caching for the run window.
- Transfer mechanism: presigned S3 is easiest for us (we'll rotate keys and log access).

I'll prep the MAP spreadsheet skeleton with owners & deliverables so Priya can attach it to the NDA.

—Ben
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

Quoted earlier: "Proposed timeline..."
From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@stacorp.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Jennings <alice@stacorp.com>, STACorp Legal <legal@stacorp.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial request — sharing eval dataset + testcases for MAP

Thanks Priya — that sounds reasonable. A couple of clarifications from our side (legal copied):

- Evaluation-only: yes, no production inference and no model retraining.
- Retention: STACorp needs a hard deletion confirmation after 30 days with proof (audit log entry + deletion event). Would Redwood be able to provide a signed statement / S3 object deletion confirmation?
- Derivatives: we would allow embeddings to be used transiently for evaluation, but not stored persistently or used in model updates. If Redwood needs to store embeddings for debugging, that should be disclosed and limited to named engineers.
- Transfer: presigned S3 OK. We'll send the presigned link once NDA is in place.

Also, small ask on timelines: our procurement window is tight. If you can accept the proposed timeline and create the MAP spreadsheet today, we can aim to deliver the dataset tomorrow (2026-07-02).

Thanks,
Tom Reyes
ML Platform Lead, STACorp

Attachments: none
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@stacorp.com>, Alice Jennings <alice@stacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, STACorp Legal <legal@stacorp.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: STACorp evaluation data exchange — timeline & usage guardrails

Tom / Alice — thanks for the quick turn. Attached is the MAP spreadsheet (MAP-STACorp-Redwood-v1.xlsx) and a sample prompt pack (prompt-pack-sample.zip). I also created a DocuSign envelope with the short eval NDA and a signature block for both parties: https://www.docusign.com/Agreement/rdw-1842-MAP

Summary of agreed guardrails (to be captured in the MAP):
- Purpose: evaluation-only. No production serving, no model training without explicit written consent.
- Retention: Redwood will delete dataset + embeddings 30 days after evaluation completion. Deletion will be recorded in our audit logs and we will provide the deletion object with timestamp as proof.
- Embeddings: ephemeral caching permitted during runs; persistent storage prohibited unless STACorp signs the Data Retention Addendum. Any temporary storage for debugging is limited to named engineers and automatically purged after 7 days.
- Access: limited to Tom Reyes and Alice Jennings on STACorp side; Redwood access limited to Priya, Ben, and Monica (listed in MAP).
- Deliverables & owners: MAP spreadsheet lists deliverables, dates, and acceptance criteria.

Next steps:
1) Alice / STACorp to sign DocuSign NDA + confirm delivery mechanism (please send presigned S3 link).
2) STACorp uploads dataset (target 2026-07-02) and prompt pack.
3) Redwood starts ingestion & baseline runs (2026-07-02 to 2026-07-06) and provides report by 2026-07-06.

If STACorp legal has any redlines to the one-page NDA, please flag them in DocuSign; we can turn around small edits same day.

Thanks — I'll watch for the presigned link and the signed NDA.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-STACorp-Redwood-v1.xlsx; prompt-pack-sample.zip
